manifest.outcome: absolute difference between prior-study and latest-year median exact IC50 pActivity >= 1.0 log10 unit

outcome_definition: absolute difference between prior-study and latest-year median exact IC50 pActivity >= 1.0 log10 unit
scientific_conclusion: The prespecified full model did not establish reliable prediction beyond simple baselines. Full PR-AUC=0.609; target-only=0.515; molecular-only=0.512; earlier-evidence-only=0.559. Performance is reported as predictive association only; no evidence component is claimed transferable unless its ablation improves independently evaluated performance with compatible uncertainty.
